description: This file defines various sampler classes used in data loading for PyTorch, including base and specialized samplers like SequentialSampler, RandomSampler, SubsetRandomSampler, WeightedRandomSampler, and BatchSampler.

classes.name: Sampler
classes.description: Base class for all sampler implementations, providing an interface for iteration over dataset indices.

classes.name: SequentialSampler
classes.description: Samples dataset elements sequentially in order.

classes.name: RandomSampler
classes.description: Samples dataset elements randomly, with or without replacement.

classes.name: SubsetRandomSampler
classes.description: Samples elements randomly from a specified list of indices without replacement.

classes.name: WeightedRandomSampler
classes.description: Samples elements based on specified weights, with options for replacement.

classes.name: BatchSampler
classes.description: Wraps another sampler to yield mini-batches of indices.

methods.name: __iter__
methods.description: Defines iteration behavior for each sampler class.

methods.name: __len__
methods.description: Returns the length of the sampler or batch.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes each sampler with relevant parameters.

methods.name: num_samples
methods.description: Property that returns the number of samples to draw in RandomSampler.
